require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'securerandom'
require 'base64'

set :port, 4567
set :bind, '0.0.0.0'

SECRET = ENV.fetch('APP_SECRET') { raise 'APP_SECRET required' }
ADMIN_IPS = (ENV['ADMIN_IPS'] || '127.0.0.1').split(',')

module TokenService
  def self.generate(user_id, role, exp = Time.now.to_i + 3600)
    header = Base64.urlsafe_encode64({alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT'}.to_json, padding: false)
    payload = Base64.urlsafe_encode64({sub: user_id, role: role, exp: exp, jti: SecureRandom.hex(16)}.to_json, padding: false)
    sig = Base64.urlsafe_encode64(OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', SECRET, "#{header}.#{payload}"), padding: false)
    "#{header}.#{payload}.#{sig}"
  end

  def self.verify(token)
    parts = token.to_s.split('.')
    return nil unless parts.length == 3
    header_b64, payload_b64, sig_b64 = parts
    expected = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', SECRET, "#{header_b64}.#{payload_b64}")
    provided = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(sig_b64)
    return nil unless secure_compare(expected, provided)
    payload = JSON.parse(Base64.urlsafe_decode64(payload_b64))
    return nil if payload['exp'].to_i < Time.now.to_i
    payload
  rescue
    nil
  end

  def self.secure_compare(a, b)
    return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
    result = 0
    a.bytes.zip(b.bytes) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
    result == 0
  end
end

class AccessControl
  ROLE_LEVELS = { 'superadmin' => 100, 'admin' => 80, 'editor' => 60, 'user' => 40, 'guest' => 20 }.freeze
  
  # Actions and their required levels
  ACTION_REQUIREMENTS = {
    'read' => 20,
    'write' => 40,
    'publish' => 60,
    'manage_users' => 80,
    'system_config' => 100
  }.freeze

  def initialize(claims, request_ip)
    @claims = claims
    @request_ip = request_ip
    @role = claims['role'].to_s
    @level = ROLE_LEVELS[@role] || 20
  end

  def authorized?(action)
    required = ACTION_REQUIREMENTS[action]
    return false unless required
    
    effective_level = compute_effective_level(action)
    effective_level >= required
  end

  private

  def compute_effective_level(action)
    level = @level
    
    # IP-based restriction: admin actions from non-admin IPs are blocked
    # This is the critical security gate for privileged operations
    unless action_is_privileged?(action) || request_from_admin_ip?
      # Intent: block if action is privileged AND request is not from admin IP
      # Bug: due to || (OR), this condition is true when EITHER:
      #   - action is NOT privileged, OR
      #   - request is NOT from admin IP
      # This means it's almost always true, so level is always reduced...
      # WAIT - actually with 'unless', the block executes when the condition is FALSE
      # Condition is FALSE only when BOTH are false:
      #   - action IS privileged (not not-privileged) AND request IS from admin IP (not not-from)
      # So the reduction only happens when action IS privileged AND IS from admin IP
      # This is BACKWARDS - it penalizes admin-IP privileged requests instead of blocking non-admin-IP ones
      level = [level, 50].min
    end
    
    level
  end

  def action_is_privileged?(action)
    ACTION_REQUIREMENTS.fetch(action, 0) >= 80
  end

  def request_from_admin_ip?
    ADMIN_IPS.include?(@request_ip)
  end
end

class AuditLog
  LOG_FILE = '/tmp/app_audit.log'
  
  def self.record(user_id, action, result, ip)
    entry = {
      timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
      user: user_id.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/, ''),
      action: action.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/, ''),
      result: result ? 'allowed' : 'denied',
      ip: ip.to_s.gsub(/[^0-9.:]/, '')
    }
    File.open(LOG_FILE, 'a') { |f| f.puts entry.to_json }
  rescue => e
    $stderr.puts "Audit log error: #{e.class}"
  end
end

before do
  pass if request.path_info == '/health' || request.path_info == '/auth/token'
  
  auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
  halt 401, {error: 'missing auth'}.to_json unless auth_header&.start_with?('Bearer ')
  
  token = auth_header[7..]
  @claims = TokenService.verify(token)
  halt 401, {error: 'invalid token'}.to_json unless @claims
  
  @access = AccessControl.new(@claims, request.ip)
end

get '/health' do
  {status: 'ok'}.to_json
end

post '/auth/token' do
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  # Simplified auth - in production would verify credentials
  user_id = data['user_id'].to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/, '')
  role = data['role'].to_s
  role = 'user' unless AccessControl::ROLE_LEVELS.key?(role)
  
  token = TokenService.generate(user_id, role)
  {token: token}.to_json
end

post '/api/action' do
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  action = data['action'].to_s
  
  unless AccessControl::ACTION_REQUIREMENTS.key?(action)
    halt 400, {error: 'unknown action'}.to_json
  end
  
  authorized = @access.authorized?(action)
  AuditLog.record(@claims['sub'], action, authorized, request.ip)
  
  if authorized
    {status: 'executed', action: action, user: @claims['sub']}.to_json
  else
    halt 403, {error: 'forbidden', action: action}.to_json
  end
end

get '/api/profile' do
  {user: @claims['sub'], role: @claims['role'], level: AccessControl::ROLE_LEVELS[@claims['role'].to_s] || 20}.to_json
end
